title: Groupoïdes de Teichmüller et les S0 Tg,!ν, S0 TG : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from the surrounding pages): X is a curve of combinatorial type G, a graph whose edges are nodes/marked pairs. C is a set of edges of G, and \tilde C (two points x', x'' over each x in C) is its preimage on the normalisation. Choose small holomorphic disks D_{\tilde x} around the points of \tilde C. Removing them gives a holomorphic surface with boundary X_1. Each boundary circle T_{\tilde x} = \partial D_{\tilde x} is a U-torsor, U = S^1, with orientation opposite to the one induced from X_1. It is canonically the circle of real tangent directions T_{\tilde x}X/R_{>0}. For each x, the space of anti-isomorphisms T_{x'} -> T_{x''} is a U-torsor T_x = T_{x'} \wedge T_{x''}. The product P_C = \prod_{x in C} T_x is a U^C-torsor.

This page:
(1) As \mathcal X = (X, (D_{\tilde x})) varies over the (topological) multiplicity M^C_G of type-G curves equipped with such disks, the P_{\mathcal X} form a U^C-torsor \tilde M^C_G -> M^C_G. The marginal note says it is the pull-back of an evident torsor P_{G,C} on M_G, namely the unit-circle bundle of the tensor product of the tangent lines at the two branches.
(2) Plumbing / holomorphic surgery. For t = (t_x) in P_C, glue the two boundary circles of X_1 over each x by the anti-isomorphism t_x. The result is a curve X'_t of type G', the type obtained by smoothing the nodes in C. Letting (\mathcal X, t) vary gives a morphism of topoi \tilde M^C_G -> M_{G'}. This is a 'real-analytic gluing with twist parameters' map from a circle bundle over a boundary stratum into the less degenerate stratum.
(3) The space of disk choices is contractible, so M^C_G -> M_G is a homotopy equivalence. The torsor then gives an extension 1 -> Z^C = \pi_1(U^C) -> \pi_1(\tilde M^C_G) -> \pi_1(M_G) -> 1, together with a homomorphism \pi_1(\tilde M^C_G) -> \pi_1(M_{G'}). In modern terms: the stabiliser of a multicurve in the mapping class group. It is a central extension by the free abelian group generated by the Dehn twists along the vanishing curves C, over the mapping class group of the cut surface, and it maps into Mod(G').
(4) Toward the 'special' Teichmüller groupoids S T_G (fundamental groupoids of principal U^{\hat A}-bundles SP_G of unit tangent directions at all edges/marked points, i.e. tangential base points), he introduces SP_{G'} over M_{G'}, principal under U^{\hat A'}. He prepares to show that the surgery map lifts to give S T_G -> S T_{G'}.

Purpose: construct the functorial 'gluing / degeneration' morphisms between the Teichmüller groupoids of all types. These are the arrows of the Teichmüller tower of the Esquisse, needed for the Galois action, done here transcendentally via circle bundles and twist parameters.
errors: 't \in T_C' should be t \in P_C (the U^C-torsor defined on the previous page); notation slip.
The map \tilde M^C_G -> M_{G'} is only a continuous / real-analytic morphism of topoi (it depends on the disks), not holomorphic. Grothendieck correctly works in a topological multiplicity.
Injectivity of Z^C -> \pi_1(\tilde M^C_G) uses \pi_2(M_G) = 0, i.e. the K(\pi,1) property of moduli orbifolds (Teichmüller space contractible). This is true but left implicit.

Strictly, the boundary stratum's \pi_1 should be that of the possibly disconnected cut surface with ordered branches. Swaps of x', x'' (graph automorphisms) are tacitly handled by the multiplicity structure.

ideas.what: U-torsor of unit tangent directions at a point; at a node, T_{x'} \wedge T_{x''} (anti-isomorphisms of boundary circles) as the circle of gluing parameters
ideas.modern_name: unit circle bundle of the normal bundle L_{x'}^\vee \otimes L_{x''}^\vee of the boundary divisor; real oriented blow-up / Kato–Nakayama log boundary

ideas.what: Holomorphic surgery (plumbing) of a curve with boundary circles glued by twist parameters, giving a map from a circle bundle over a boundary stratum to the open stratum M_{G'}
ideas.modern_name: plumbing / Fenchel–Nielsen twist gluing; gluing maps of the modular operad on frame bundles
ideas.usually_credited_to: Fay, Wolpert, Bers (plumbing); Getzler–Kapranov (modular operads); Kimura–Stasheff–Voronov
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme alludes to the Teichmüller tower and 'chirurgie' but gives no construction

ideas.what: Exact sequence 1 -> Z^C -> \pi_1(\tilde M^C_G) -> \pi_1(M_G) -> 1 mapping into \pi_1(M_{G'})
ideas.modern_name: multicurve stabiliser in the mapping class group: central extension by Dehn twists along vanishing cycles
ideas.usually_credited_to: Birman, Ivanov; Harer; used for the Teichmüller tower by Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps, Nakamura

ideas.what: Special Teichmüller groupoids S T_G as \pi_1 of principal U^{\hat A}-bundles of unit tangent vectors at all nodes and marks, with functorial maps S T_G -> S T_{G'}
ideas.modern_name: Teichmüller groupoid with tangential base points; Lego-Teichmüller game; framed / modular-operad structure on mapping class groupoids

missed.claim: A concrete transcendental construction of the morphisms of the Teichmüller tower in all types, with tangential (frame) torsors at nodes, predating the later published versions (Nakamura's tangential base points, Bakalov–Kirillov). It is uniform over arbitrary stable graph types G -> G' via a twist torsor P_C and a morphism of topoi \tilde M^C_G -> M_{G'}.
missed.quote: les P_X forment un U^C_{M^C_G}-torseur sur M^C_G, dit \tilde M^C_G, et on définira une morphisme de topos \tilde M^C_G -> M_{G'}
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Historical priority for the framed modular-operad / tangential-base-point formalism underlying Grothendieck–Teichmüller theory. The content itself is now standard.

deep.surprise_reason: A clean and early unpublished construction of the gluing maps between Teichmüller groupoids with tangential frames, matching later work by Nakamura, Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps and Bakalov–Kirillov. Mathematically it is now standard, so the interest is mainly historical.
transcription_corrections: First line likely 'variable dans une multiplicité topologique quelconque comme celle M^C_G', not 'multiplicité topos? quelque'.
Marginal note: 'c'est l'image inverse d'un torseur évident sur M_G, P_{G,C} ou P_C sur ...'
'une [-...-] X' de type G'' should be 'une [courbe] X' de type G''.
't = (t_x)_{x\in C} \in T_C' is likely intended as P_C.
Under 'Soit M_G' the struck text possibly reads 'M_{G'}'; the intended object is M_G, the holomorphic multiplicity of curves of type G.
